verse.text: Only the living can praise you as I do today. Each generation tells of your faithfulness to the next.

reflection: Every dad is writing a story his kids will retell one day — in the way he prays before meals, admits when he's wrong, or shows up tired but present. You don't need a perfect testimony to pass on a real one; you just need to keep telling your kids, in word and action, that God has been faithful to you. That's how one generation hands its faith to the next.
